name: type-decomposer
description: Decompose, design, and grade a type or schema (domain model, JSON Schema, protobuf, SQL DDL) on two crossing axes — MODEL (domain → state-space → sums vs products → invariants → evolution) and VALIDITY (well-formed → sound → instances → round-trip → migration) — scored separately around 'make illegal states unrepresentable', proven by a JSON-Schema-subset validator that runs a legal instance set (all must validate) and an illegal instance set (all must be rejected), plus a model-smell linter.
